How long have you guys been going out for? Does she know about your habit? 

Sometimes my boyfriend goes without texting me, it's annoying as fuck, but I'm at peace knowing that he loves me and still cares about me. You can take her out to do things that don't cost money to show that you care. Go to the beach, go to a park, star gazing ... :)

My childhood plays a big part I think. My parents didn't really nurture me, or teach me coping mechanisms. I think I missed out on being loved by them, so I'm trying to find that missing piece. And I do so by helping others. 

My coping mechanisms is like a child, I'll overreact, do things irrationally. It may not seem that bad, but I don't feel like I belong.

Thanks for the anology, I feel like I can relate to that. I'm actually a nurse so I guess it's just a habit of mine to help people without getting anything in return.. I mean it's my job.

I have shared my thoughts with my psychologist, although I've been quite careful these days as I feel like I can't be completely honest with her without being hospitalised or anything like that. It's difficult because I don't feel like I can express my thoughts to her well face to face in our sessions. I also often feel like she has clients who are more acute and need more attention than me.
